subject: Optim error when running parboot GoF tests

messages.author: 44fe34efe1d6456b
messages.subject: Optim error when running parboot GoF tests
parts:
Hi All,

I am attempting to work with negative binomial N mixture removal models, and I am new to the world of R! I have had no issues fitting the models, but when I ran a GoF on ANY of my models, I received an error (No errors were given when fitting the models, just when running GoF). If I do not specify it as a negative binomial, the GoF runs fine, and I can't find the source of my issue. I have included some of my code below. I would greatly appreciate any input! Thank you in advance!

Alissa


> chrysnb.umf <- unmarkedFrameGMM(y=chrys,
+                              siteCovs=data.frame(edgeveg = edgeveg, canopy = canopy, prey = prey, cwd = cwd, totveg = totveg, 
+                                                  domveg = domveg, ph = ph, do = do, conduc = conduc, type = type, depth = depth,

> fitstats130 <- function(fm130) {
+   observed <- getY(fm130@data)
+   expected <- fitted(fm130)
+   resids <- residuals(fm130)
+   sse <- sum(resids^2)
+   chisq <- sum((observed - expected)^2 / expected)
+   freeTuke <- sum((sqrt(observed) - sqrt(expected))^2)
+   out <- c(SSE=sse, Chisq=chisq, freemanTukey=freeTuke)
+   return(out)
+ }
> (goftest130 <- parboot(fm130, fitstats, nsim=100, report=1))
